status: editorial context vocabulary; automatic Studio suggestions are proposed
duration_note: Bar counts are adjustable starter realizations, not universal rules. Resolve the actual meter and tempo map.

patterns.name: Stable groove, final-bar fill
patterns.summary: Reuse the pocket and write a clear exit only at the end.

patterns.name: Question and answer
patterns.summary: Keep an identifiable question and let its answer change the ending.

patterns.name: Presentation and continuation
patterns.summary: Present an idea twice, then develop fragments toward an arrival.

patterns.name: Open phrase, closed answer
patterns.summary: Make the second phrase answer the first with a more settled destination.

patterns.name: Same hook, different exit
patterns.summary: Recognizable hook material returns with an ending that leads onward.

patterns.name: Verse–chorus cycles
patterns.summary: Repeat the section relationship while developing selected occurrences.

patterns.name: AABA with a contrasting bridge
patterns.summary: A contrasting middle passage makes the final familiar return meaningful.

patterns.name: Refrain and contrasting episodes
patterns.summary: A recurring refrain anchors distinct continuous episodes.

patterns.name: Twelve-bar blues chorus
patterns.summary: Keep the harmonic frame while writing fresh phrases and chorus-to-chorus development.

patterns.name: Major ii–V arrival
patterns.summary: Use a short predominant–dominant route only when it fits the destination and melody.

patterns.name: Major IV to minor iv color
patterns.summary: Let one chromatic inner line provide a gentle change of color before the return.

patterns.name: Continuous melody above recurring accompaniment
patterns.summary: A stable groove leaves room for a complete new melodic sentence.
allow: melody notes and expression through the whole span

patterns.name: Continuous development toward an arrival
patterns.summary: Develop a small motif across the full assigned passage without automatic phrase tiling.

patterns.name: Golden suspension and familiar resolution
patterns.summary: Hold one golden-colored voice and give it an audible destination over a stable support.

patterns.name: One-time bridge into a new key
patterns.summary: Interrupt a recurring form once and connect two specified tonal destinations.
